review_summary: Students consistently describe instructor Mera (Merhawi) as patient, calm and clear, with many saying they passed in one go; the most substantive testimonials come from Google Maps and several are written in English by international learners. The bulk of the rijschoolspecialist reviews are very short, generic one-line praise.

red_flags: On rijschoolspecialist.nl most of the 28 reviews are very short generic one-liners ('De beste rijschool mera', 'Hij is Top rij instructeur', 'Beste rijschool. Mera') with little specific detail
Reviewer names on rijschoolspecialist are heavily concentrated in one community (Eritrean/Tigrinya), and the cluster of near-identical 5-star praise suggests solicited community reviews
Only one of 28 rijschoolspecialist ratings is below 5 stars; no negative, mixed or lukewarm reviews appear on any platform
No independent verified-platform reviews (klantenvertellen/Kiyoh) exist for this school; substance rests on a handful of Google Maps reviews
Single-instructor sole proprietorship, so the review base is small
verified_reviews_note: No klantenvertellen / Kiyoh page found for Rijles Mera; quotes drawn from Google Maps (via rijloket) and rijschoolspecialist.nl.
